name: Amazon Kindle (11th generation, 2024 release), code name Rossini

candidate_rule_from_source.status: unverified: derived from U-Boot source, not from a device

identification.note: The rule is not active until a real KT6's board_id has been read and matches. Then it is added to `rules`.

soc.value: MediaTek MT8512 family ('MT8110 Bellatrix' platform), 32-bit ARM (Cortex-A7 per mt8512.dtsi PMU node), PSCI 0.2

bootloader.value: U-Boot UFBL, signed FIT, secure boot fuses, anti-rollback, fastboot with Amazon-issued unlock
bootloader.policy: locked: third-party kernels are rejected on production devices

display.note: base_rotation 90 is an assumption for a landscape-native panel; check fb0 rotate/geometry on the device

battery.value: ROHM BD71828 power supply bd71827_bat / bd71827_ac

storage_layout.value: eMMC; partition 'kernel' holds the FIT image

blockers: Locked production bootloader: signed FIT with Amazon production key + anti-rollback; unlock requires Amazon (source of the unlock check is not published)
